assessment: Single-particle tomography (SPT) is a useful method to determine the structure of proteins imaged in situ. This important work presents an easy-to-use tool for SPT that approximates the use of 2D tomographic projections using a ‘pseudo-subtomogram’ data structure, chosen to facilitate implementation within the existing RELION codebase. The examples shown provide solid support for the claims about the efficacy of the approach.
